issues.issue: Can the court decide the extension of time when the leave order is silent on it?
issues.respondent_position: Granting leave is not determinative of the extension; the silent leave order leaves the extension open.
issues.result_quote: is not determinative of the extension of time issue because the order for leave is silent on this point

issues.issue: Should an extension of time to seek judicial review be granted?
issues.applicant_position: Continuing intention shown; delay due to bad advice; the review is not frivolous; no prejudice.
issues.respondent_position: Respondent complained of no prejudice from the delay; other submissions not stated.
issues.result_quote: Accordingly, the application for an extension of time is granted

issues.issue: Did the visa officer decide on conjecture rather than the facts in evidence?
issues.applicant_position: Officer relied on conjecture about abandonment and normal life rather than the facts in evidence.
issues.result_quote: the application for judicial review will be heard on a date to be determined by the Judicial Administrator of this Court.
